upstream.release_subject: Release v6.3.0: Devin CLI and Hermes Agent support, brainstorming three-path router, SDD/Codex efficiency fixes
upstream.import_method: git archive <commit> -- <selected skill directories> LICENSE | tar -x

excluded.reason: Upstream's own router. This repository ships its own dual-core router; importing a second router would create competing entry points and a load-everything failure.

Ships a Node HTTP server and browser visual companion (scripts/server.cjs, start-server.sh, stop-server.sh, frame-template.html) and an upstream three-path router. Adds a runtime dependency outside this repository's Python/shell footprint and duplicates the domain/risk routing defined here.
Skill-authoring methodology. This repository already owns its skill contract (docs/SKILL_SCHEMA.md, docs/specification/SKILL_CONTRACT.md); importing a second authoring contract would duplicate it.

Ships a second orchestration contract (bash scripts plus a .superpowers/sdd workspace) parallel to the role-based WORK_PACKAGE/EVIDENCE_PACKAGE handoff defined in docs/specification/dual-core/AGENT_ORCHESTRATION.md. Two competing orchestration contracts violate the minimum-sufficient-record rule; dispatching-parallel-agents covers the parallelism need.

hash_definition: tree_sha256 = sha256 over the concatenation of '<relative-posix-path>\0<sha256-of-file-bytes>\n' for every file under the skill directory, sorted by relative path. aggregate_sha256 = sha256 over the concatenation of '<skill-name>\0<tree_sha256>\n' for every imported skill, sorted by skill name.
integrity_note: The vendored files are byte-identical to the upstream commit; no file was edited. scripts/run_dual_core_tests.py recomputes these hashes and fails if a vendored file changes.
